text: v0.5.10 opened: charter b71fa48 approved under the deterministic condition (#218 comments 7136727624 and 7136761163); time box to 2026-12-01T15:52Z. Caps 6 CPU-h, 10 GB downloads, 10 GB disk peak. Machine: business hours until 18:00 local, at most 10 workers and 2 downloads.

Part (a): recount the research's section 2 numbers from committed records (C1 report and diagnosis; C2 records of c2 and c2-prefix; v0.5.6 part B records). Choices: blocking = INCONCLUSIVE or fatal FAIL; pass rate over the decisive (stage) tests; what-ifs read the named tests as PASS; differences recorded, not explained. No new verdict.

First run: 60 match, 5 differ (C1 product 0.396 vs 0.397; C2 phi(systematics, odd_even) 0.22 vs 0.23; background 57 vs 54; median background power None; R2 variant (e) 53 vs 43). The background count and median were a reading error of the script: every systematics message names 'background' among its sub-checks, and the power is not in the message. Fix: read the structured field tests.systematics.sensitivity.background (detectable false; probability). The other three differences are kept as recorded.
Part (a), second run after the reading fix (background from the structured sensitivity record).

Second run: 61 match, 4 differ (C1 product 0.396 vs 0.397; C2 phi 0.22 vs 0.23; median background power 0.07 over the 54 background refusals vs 0.76; R2 variant (e) 53 vs 43). Recorded, not explained. Re-run gives the same bytes (recount-section2.json sha256 97f294d2418bc6843ef3865214a9cacf352192121e80408df56f9014ef2a250c).

Codex round on part (f) and its isolation (new thread): WEAKENED; blocking 1-5 and 8 without scope change, applied to the plan; blocking 9 (TLS output overlaps v0.5.9 mode S search fields; crosswalk needed, odd/even and centroid included) changes scope: per the decision of 12:51, item 3, part (f) stops for the maintainer before any engine is installed or run. Parts (a) to (d) continue.

Part (c): KELT-FP (arXiv source table, sha256 72b21cce...) against transiting planets whose pscomppars discovery facility is not TESS. Choices: SPOC 2-min = MAST TESS timeseries, provenance SPOC, t_exptime 119-121 s, any sector; exposed = v0.5.6 part-b-exposure exposed_tics plus every tic_id in the JSON records of v0.5.6 to v0.5.9; usable = 2-min and not exposed; support = 10/50/90 percent quantiles of period, depth and magnitude. Metadata only; per-target table kept under .cache.

First run: KELT-FP 1,126 unique TICs (1,128 rows), 310 with SPOC 2-min, 1,123 not exposed, 307 usable, 7 TOIs; planets not found by TESS 2,849 TICs, 2,651 with 2-min, 2,576 not exposed, 2,380 usable, 621 TOIs. Most of the planet arm is from space missions (Kepler, K2), so a ground-based subset is added (a new derived count, not a re-scoring).

Part (c), second run from the cached queries: add the planet arm's usable counts by discovery facility, and the ground-based subset (facility names no space mission: Kepler, K2, CoRoT, Spitzer, Hubble, James Webb, CHEOPS, Gaia) with its support.

Part (d): Kepler-field census. Arms: KOIs with status CERTIFIED FP in the archive's fpwg table view (rendered 2026-11-24T16:02:48Z; TAP has no fpwg table), and transiting planets whose pscomppars discovery facility is Kepler. TIC: pscomppars tic_id, or the MAST TIC catalog's KIC column. Products in MAST by TIC target name: SPOC 2-min (TESS timeseries, SPOC, 119-121 s), TESS-SPOC (FFI light curves), TGLC. Bins declared now: TESS magnitude <10, 10-12, 12-14, 14-16, >=16; depth ppm <500, 500-1000, 1000-5000, 5000-20000, >=20000. Metadata only.

First run, discarded: certified FP 1,799 with TIC (SPOC 2-min 8, TESS-SPOC 348, TGLC 0); Kepler planets 2,763 (SPOC 2-min 2,548, TESS-SPOC 2,548, TGLC 0). A bug in the script's cache: mast_targets cached results by batch index, not by TIC, so the SPOC 2-min batches of the d1 census (another TIC list) were reused for this list. The d1 census ran first with an empty cache and is not affected. Fix: cache per TIC; the cached MAST files of this run are set aside and the queries repeated.
Part (c), rerun with the per-TIC cache (the batch-index cache is replaced), all MAST queries repeated; same choices as census-d1 and census-d1b.
Rerun with the per-TIC cache: the same counts as census-d1b (KELT-FP 310 2-min, 307 usable; planets 2,651 2-min, 2,380 usable; ground-based usable 181).
Part (d), rerun with the per-TIC cache; the same choices and bins as census-kepler.

Rerun: certified FP 1,799 rows with TIC (1,770 unique): SPOC 2-min 289, TESS-SPOC 348, TGLC 0 found; Kepler planets 2,763 rows (1,976 hosts): SPOC 2-min 2,548, TESS-SPOC 2,548 (the same rows; checked), TGLC 0 found. TGLC: no observation under a TIC target name; MAST's naming for TGLC not confirmed, so TGLC is recorded as not determined. A background count query of TGLC in MAST did not return in time and is not used.

Part (b): predicted transit windows in sectors 110 to 120 (pages read 2026-11-24; sector 110 began 2026-10-31, data not public). Lists: eumemic predictions.csv at e2eee928, ExoFOP CTOIs (download 2026-11-24), the 3 promoted v0.4 candidates. Geometry: gnomonic projection per camera, both roll sign conventions, on silicon when |x|,|y| < 11.5 deg and > 0.25 deg from the axes in both; within 0.5 deg of an edge or disagreeing = unknown. Transits: eumemic's own per-transit predictions, else T0 + nP inside the sector dates with sigma = hypot(sigma_T0, n sigma_P). 2-min data in these sectors: not determined (lists not found); proxy = SPOC 2-min in any earlier sector.

eumemic 725 targets: 265 on silicon in at least one of sectors 110-120, 69 only unknown, 205 with a predicted transit on silicon (2,454 transits; timing sigma median 6.8 min, p90 23.9 min), 162 with 2-min history, 50 both; CTOIs 5,139: 1,507 on silicon, 1,222 with a transit (21,456 transits; sigma median 57.7 min, p90 2,274 min), 2,952 with 2-min history, 682 both; Refute's own 3: none on silicon. Geometry check against eumemic's own tess_sector column (110, 111): every target they place there is 'yes' or 'unknown' here, never 'off' (110: 38 yes, 5 unknown; 111: 28 yes, 8 unknown).

The maintainer's decision of 14:46 local (#218 comment 7139692729): part (f) option (A), a named rerun by a dated amendment to the charter (section 9). No new Codex round before the run (item 2): the round on part (f) was done, its blocking items 1 to 5 and 8 are applied, and item 9 is resolved by the amendment. The amendment's condition is checked by check_amendment_diff.py.

Part (f), blocking item 1: select, for each of the 119 pins, the one PyPI artifact for CPython 3.12 win_amd64 whose SHA-256 is pinned (tag order cp312-cp312, abi3, py3-none-win_amd64, py3-none-any, py2.py3; sdist only for fbpca), reject any uploaded at or after 2026-11-17T00:00:00Z; write wheelhouse-manifest.json; then download into .cache/v0510/engines/wheelhouse, 2 at a time, each checked.

119 artifacts selected and fetched (226,735,971 bytes downloaded), 0 rejected, latest upload 2026-11-16T00:38:39Z, every SHA-256 checked. fbpca 1.0 sdist inspected (setup.py uses setuptools only; no LICENSE file in the sdist, metadata 'BSD License' with a patent grant, not confirmed), built offline with uv build --no-build-isolation against the pinned setuptools 80.10.2 wheel: wheel sha256 9089552e.... Environment: CPython 3.12.15 (uv-managed build copied into .cache/v0510/engines/base, python.exe sha256 4a3bbd97...), venv installed offline from the wheelhouse with --require-hashes (requirements-install.txt), 119 packages. uv 0.12.24.

Part (f): fetch again the 24 TOIs' 238 files (119 light curves, 119 pixel files, 5.846 GB recorded) of the v0.5.9 fetch units' manifests from MAST, 2 downloads at a time (business hours), each checked against its recorded SHA-256; mismatches recorded and unusable. Project environment, standard library only.
238 files fetched (119 light curves, 119 pixel files), 5,845,999,680 bytes downloaded; 238 of 238 match the recorded SHA-256 (data-check.json); 0 mismatches, 0 missing hashes.

Isolation test (decision #218 comment 7140572901): create the AppContainer profile refute.v0510.engines with no capability (HKCU mapping key and <local application-data folder>/Packages folder; never deleted by the session), grant it read on .cache/v0510/engines, data, workers and write on its run folder only; a control run outside the sandbox and a sandboxed run of isolation_probe.py; expectations: every network attempt fails in the sandbox (loopback listener, 1.1.1.1:443, pypi.org:443, DNS, UDP 53), reads only granted, writes only its run folder; in the control, loopback and 1.1.1.1:443 connect.

First attempt: the profile was created (status 'created'); every network check failed in the sandbox (loopback listener timed out and accepted 0 connections; 1.1.1.1:443 PermissionError 13; pypi.org and DNS gaierror 11001; UDP 53 timed out), the control connected to the loopback listener and to 1.1.1.1:443; reads and writes as expected; but every engine import failed with PermissionError 13: uv had installed the venv as hardlinks to its cache outside the project, and those files keep their own ACL (no container entry). A scan found 0 hardlinked files with a container ACL entry, so no file outside the project was changed. Fix: the venv was deleted (inside .cache, by literal path with a guard) and installed again offline from the same wheelhouse with --link-mode=copy (19,049 files, 0 hardlinked).
Isolation test, second attempt, after the venv was installed again with copied files; the same expectations.

Second attempt passed: all 25 checks hold (isolation-test.json). In the AppContainer every network attempt fails and the loopback listener accepted 0 connections; reads succeed only on the engines, the data and the workers' folder, and writes only in the run folder; all engine imports succeed. Control outside the sandbox connects to the loopback listener and to 1.1.1.1:443.

outcome_rule: an engine output 'reaches an outcome' when its published rule (settings.json) gives threshold_met or threshold_not_met with non-zero coverage; 'unavailable' and 'no_published_threshold' do not
